1.en: By those [winds] sent forth in gusts

2.en: And the winds that blow violently

5.en: And those [angels] who deliver a message

7.en: Indeed, what you are promised is to occur.

8.en: So when the stars are obliterated

9.en: And when the heaven is opened

10.en: And when the mountains are blown away

11.en: And when the messengers' time has come...

12.en: For what Day was it postponed?

14.en: And what can make you know what is the Day of Judgement?

15.en: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.

16.en: Did We not destroy the former peoples?

17.en: Then We will follow them with the later ones.

18.en: Thus do We deal with the criminals.

19.en: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.

20.en: Did We not create you from a liquid disdained?

21.en: And We placed it in a firm lodging

23.en: And We determined [it], and excellent [are We] to determine.

24.en: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.

25.en: Have We not made the earth a container

26.en: Of the living and the dead?

27.ar: وَجَعَلْنَا فِيهَا رَوَٰسِىَ شَـٰمِخَـٰتٍ وَأَسْقَيْنَـٰكُم مَّآءً فُرَاتًا
27.en: And We placed therein lofty, firmly set mountains and have given you to drink sweet water.

28.en: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.

29.ar: ٱنطَلِقُوٓا۟ إِلَىٰ مَا كُنتُم بِهِۦ تُكَذِّبُونَ
29.en: [They will be told], "Proceed to that which you used to deny.

30.ar: ٱنطَلِقُوٓا۟ إِلَىٰ ظِلٍّ ذِى ثَلَـٰثِ شُعَبٍ
30.en: Proceed to a shadow [of smoke] having three columns

31.ar: لَّا ظَلِيلٍ وَلَا يُغْنِى مِنَ ٱللَّهَبِ
31.en: [But having] no cool shade and availing not against the flame."

32.en: Indeed, it throws sparks [as huge] as a fortress,

33.en: As if they were yellowish [black] camels.

34.en: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.

35.en: This is a Day they will not speak,

36.en: Nor will it be permitted for them to make an excuse.

37.en: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.

38.en: This is the Day of Judgement; We will have assembled you and the former peoples.

39.en: So if you have a plan, then plan against Me.

40.en: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.

41.en: Indeed, the righteous will be among shades and springs

42.en: And fruits from whatever they desire,

43.ar: كُلُوا۟ وَٱشْرَبُوا۟ هَنِيٓـًٔۢا بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
43.en: [Being told], "Eat and drink in satisfaction for what you used to do."

44.en: Indeed, We thus reward the doers of good.

45.en: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.

46.en: [O disbelievers], eat and enjoy yourselves a little; indeed, you are criminals.

47.en: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.

48.ar: وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمُ ٱرْكَعُوا۟ لَا يَرْكَعُونَ
48.en: And when it is said to them, "Bow [in prayer]," they do not bow.

49.en: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.

50.en: Then in what statement after the Qur'an will they believe?
